contribution_boundary: The \(2/3\) star upper bound is pre-existing; the contribution is the \(2/3\) lower bound for all six nonnegative four-vertex edge rates.
integrity: Analytic proof is self-contained modulo standard elementary Specht facts and the cited established Aldous inequality; accompanying symbolic/numerical script is supplementary and is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Proves only the four-vertex weighted case; does not resolve the arbitrary-order conjecture, classify all equality configurations, or derive mixing-time bounds.
title: Sharp \(2/3\) Specht spectral comparison for every weighted four-vertex graph
